fee_details:
- Annual fee: Rs.500(However, annual spend exceeds Rs.50,000 in the previous year)
- Joining fee: Rs.500
joining_perks: First year fee waiver on spending of Rs.20,000.
reward_structure:
- Earn 5% of spend as Fuel Points at HPCL and IndianOil fuel outlets, bill payments & utilities.
- Earn 1.5X per Rs. 150 spent on other purchases.
- 1% of fuel surcharge waiver on all transactions.
key_highlights:
- Earn 5% of spend as Fuel Points at HPCL and IndianOil fuel outlets, bill payments & utilities.
- Earn 1.5X per Rs. 150 spent on other purchases.
- 1% of fuel surcharge waiver on all transactions.
- Annual renewal fee waived if annual spend is above Rs.50,000 in the previous year.
- The Fuel Points accumulated can be redeemed towards IndianOil fuel (upto Rs.4000/Rs.6000)

benefits_features.Fuel Benefits:
Earn 5% of your fuel spends as Fuel Points.
At any IndianOil petrol pump, get up to 250 Fuel Points each month for the first 6 months.
Post 6 months, get 150 Fuel Points in a month.
1% fuel surcharge will be waived on all transaction ranging between Rs.500 and above.
benefits_features.Fuel Point Benefits:
For every 150 spent on other categories, get an approx. of 15 Fuel Points.
On all bill payments and groceries, get 5% of your spends as fuel points.
benefits_features.Milestone Benefits: The renewal fee of Rs.500 will be waived if your annual spends exceeds Rs.50,000 in a year.
benefits_features.Other Benefits:
Get automatic PayZapp activation at issuance.  Transaction amount minimum of Rs.250 within first 90 days of card issuance.
Regalia from SmartBuy will be available to you for free.

fees_and_charges.Minimum repayment amount: 5% of the total outstanding amount subject to a minimum of Rs.200
fees_and_charges.Cash advance fee at HDFC Bank ATM or oth: 2.5% of the transaction amount subject to a minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Cash advance fee at International ATMs: 3.5% of the transaction amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Cheque fee: Cheque value of up to Rs.5000: Rs.25. Cheque value of more than Rs.5000: Rs.50
fees_and_charges.Payment return charges: 2% of the payment amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.600
fees_and_charges.Balance transfer processing charges: 5% of the balance transfer amount or Rs.250. The higher amount will be taken
fees_and_charges.Over limit payment: 2.5% of the over limit amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Fuel surcharge: 1% of offered purchase amount will be waived

miscellaneous: The IndianOil HDFC Bank credit card is specially curated for the people who own transport or travel often around the country. The card offers a wider variety of benefits, especially the fuel category along with others. The IndianOil HDFC Bank credit card comes with an annual fee of Rs.500 and a monthly interest rate of 3.49%.

faqs.Are there reward points inside the India: Yes, there are reward points (points like fuel points) issued by the bank. Soon after this card is issued, you will receive Fuel Points which can be redeemed.
faqs.What is the monthly interest rate on the: HDFC Bank will charge you 3.49% per month as the interest rate. Annually, it fluctuates up to 43.88%.
faqs.What is the fuel surcharge waiver of the: The fuel surcharge will be waived off for all fuel transactions with the credit card. The minimum purchase amount must be Rs.500; however, there is no upper limit.
